forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @jgd ,

Today there is no plan to bring the software support for this IP in OpenSTLinux due to lack of use cases.

Kind regards,

Erwan.
forum.content_text: Hello ST community. I am trying to understand the support the otfdec <https://wiki.st.com/stm32mpu/wiki/OTFDEC_internal_peripheral> internal device has or will have in the OpenSTLinux. Can anyone suggest reading material on supporting the otfdec for mp2?
forum.author: jgd

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @jgd ,
Today there is no plan to bring the software support for this IP in OpenSTLinux due to lack of use cases.

Kind regards,
Erwan.
